Vendored API Anything core

Source: https://github.com/goodnight000/api-anything
Commit: 1788526eb54ff1f0d8bd7373bd5fdcac143ad7ad
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

Only core modules and the upstream LinkedIn read recipes are included.
The browser module adds an opt-in request policy used by Site Harness.
The login module adds an opt-in desktop session import policy, which Site Harness disables.
The original Git blob hashes are recorded in UPSTREAM.json.
No browser, dependency or third-party executable is installed at runtime.
